title: PME2 Menu Export Format
description: Pie Menu Editor 2 JSON export/import format. schema_version 2.0.

$schema.description: Must be the URL of this schema document.

addon_version.description: Version of the PME addon that exported this file.

exported_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when this file was exported.

tags.description: All tags referenced by menus in this file.

RootExtensions.description: File-level vendor extensions. Unknown vendor namespaces remain allowed.

PmeRootExtension.description: PME-owned file extension payloads. Unknown PME siblings remain allowed.

TagRegistryEnvelope.description: Tag registry identity definitions. Version 1 treats definition array order as non-semantic; version 2 uses it as the canonical manual Tag order.

PmiUid.description: Parent-menu-scoped stable identifier for a menu item, e.g. 'pmi_f7c2k3ha'.

ActionType.description: Type of action a menu item performs.

key_mod.description: Regular key used as a modifier.

chord.description: Second key in a CHORDS sequence.

keymaps.description: Keymap(s) to register this hotkey in.

Style.description: Visual style overrides (experimental, stored under extensions.pme.style).

button_background_color.description: FPANEL COMMAND button background color. Field presence enables the override; omit it to use the theme default.

PmeMenuExtensions.description: Menu-level extensions. Unknown extension namespaces remain allowed; extensions.pme.logic is the shared PME Logic payload discriminated by menu mode.

PmeLogic.description: Shared PME Logic envelope stored at menu.extensions.pme.logic. CONDITION documents accept PropertyStackLogic. ROUTER documents accept ContextRouterLogic.

PmeLogicValueSource.description: Canonical shared address for a readable PME Logic condition value. RNA sources use bounded segments; PM references use UID-backed paths.

PmeLogicValueSourceSegment.description: One bounded RNA path segment. index_source contains one non-recursive UID-backed integer PME PROPERTY reference.

PmeLogicConditionOperator.description: Canonical operator vocabulary shared by PME Logic condition rows.

PmeLogicPredicateValue.description: Canonical PME Logic predicate comparison value. Enum and enum_set multi values are stored as arrays of identifiers.

PmeLogicConditionRow.description: Canonical shared condition row for persisted PME Logic authoring. This shape uses source.kind as the source discriminator and keeps runtime evaluation facts out of Schema v2.

ContextRouterEventModifierConditionRow.description: Context Router-only condition row for invocation event modifier evidence. This is not a PmeLogicValueSource and does not persist a live bpy.types.Event.

ContextRouterConditionRow.description: Context Router condition list item. RNA/property conditions use the shared PME Logic condition row; invocation event evidence uses a Router-owned event variant.

ContextRouterEmptyOpts.description: Options for Context Router hotkey and custom target actions. COMMAND and current MENU targets use their shared PMI option vocabulary.

ContextRouterMenuTargetOpts.description: Presentation options owned by a current Context Router MENU target. Absence means the target is invoked rather than expanded.

ContextRouterTargetActionV1.description: Published Context Router v1 target action. MENU, HOTKEY, and CUSTOM options remain closed and empty.

ContextRouterTargetAction.description: Action-compatible subset used by current Context Router branch targets. MENU presentation is owned by the selected target action, not by a parent MENU-to-ROUTER link.

ContextRouterTargetPresentation.description: Optional Context Router target presentation intent. Absence means auto_icon=false.

ContextRouterTargetV1.description: Published Context Router v1 target shape. It remains closed and does not admit presentation fields.

ContextRouterTarget.description: Context Router v2 durable target intent. action=null means an intentionally saved but unconfigured target; fallback_name is display/diagnostics provenance, not identity.

ContextRouterBranchV1.description: One ordered Context Router v1 branch.

ContextRouterBranch.description: One ordered Context Router branch. Order is semantic because the first matching branch wins.

ContextRouterOtherwiseV1.description: Fallback target used by Context Router v1.

ContextRouterOtherwise.description: Fallback target used when no Context Router branch matches.

ContextRouterLogicV1.description: Published Context Router v1 durable authoring payload.

ContextRouterLogicV2.description: Context Router v2 durable authoring payload with target presentation intent.

ContextRouterLogic.description: Context Router durable authoring payload stored at menu.extensions.pme.logic. Readers accept published v1 and current v2; canonical writers emit v2.

PropertyStackLogic.description: Property Stack durable authoring payload stored at menu.extensions.pme.logic.

VectorMenuItemExtension.description: Vector Menu item extensions stored under extensions.pme.vector_menu.

enum_strategy.description: Per-PROP enum presentation override for VMENU items. Omit to use the global Vector Menu enum strategy.

PropDisplayItemExtension.description: Property display item extensions stored under extensions.pme.prop_display.

use_property_split.description: Per-PROP Property Split override for DIALOG/FPANEL items. Omit to inherit the menu-level Property Split setting.

OperatorPresentationItemExtension.description: Operator presentation authoring intent stored under extensions.pme.presentation.

auto_icon.description: Prefer an inferred Blender Tool icon where supported while retaining item.icon as the fallback.

PMEItemExtension.description: PME item-level extensions stored under extensions.pme.

undo.description: If true, use undo-enabled COMMAND fallback execution.

MenuExpandGeometry.description: Caller-local width and XY offset for an expanded MENU target. Omitted width means Auto and omitted offsets mean zero. Import additionally enforces a vector magnitude limit of 8192 after float32 normalization.

MenuActionOpts.description: Options for action.type='menu'. Unknown established MENU options remain allowed for Schema v2 compatibility.

Action.description: Action performed when a menu item is activated.

value.description: Command string, uid reference, or '' for layout types.

MenuItem.description: A single item within a menu.
